narrative.overview: Warm enough for human judgment, structured enough for precise agent provenance, and quiet until two directions intersect.

rules.name: The Consequence Rule
rules.body: Green means current coordination. Amber means a human choice is needed. Neither color is decorative.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif identifies the project and consequential reasoning. Sans-serif carries every action, state, and piece of evidence.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface is not asking for a decision or temporarily interrupting the workflow, it does not receive a shadow.

dos: Do lead every project with the proposed-work check and active direction.
Do keep rationale, actor, runtime, and path scope adjacent to material intent.
Do keep empty states instructional: declare work, accrue intent, catch divergence.
donts: Don't build a generic admin dashboard organized around object types, counts, and CRUD controls.
Don't make a decision wiki that presents historical notes as settled organizational law.
Don't use neon agent-control interfaces, anthropomorphic bot theatres, or decorative AI imagery.
